development.address: Holland Link (corner Holland Plain × Holland Link), Holland Plain precinct, D10
development.orientation_notes: Eleven 4-6 storey blocks on a 17,069 sqm corner plot bounded by Holland Plain and Holland Link, ringed by GCB land (Brizay Park / Ewart Park / Garlick Ave) with Holland Green Linear Park (Rail Corridor connector) adjacent and a side gate to a future NParks neighbourhood park. Artist impressions show balconies facing Holland Plain / the linear park. Per-block numbering, compass facings and which stacks hold the 48 Luxe (private-lift) units are NOT verified from text sources — showflat digital stack selector reportedly shows orientations toward the Rail Corridor and GCB areas. Sim Lian's plot 2 (~280 units, launch 2Q2027, build ~2027-2031) is the 'neighbouring' parcel — the side it abuts is unverified; blocks on that boundary face 3-4 years of construction and a permanent view change. Amenities: none inside the precinct yet (Bukit Timah Plaza / KAP mall ~1km).
known_issues: Pre-launch: zero transactions; all pricing indicative until booking 26 Sep 2026
MRT distance disputed: 680m (marketing) / ~1,013m (projecthome) / 1.6km (PropertyGuru) — walk to King Albert Park DTL is 8-15 min depending on source; CRL interchange 2032
New precinct: 7 more Holland Plain GLS plots (~2,300 further homes) to be built out around it through the 2030s; plot 2 construction next door 2027-2031
No 1BR/2BR — 3BR is the entry ticket at $2.568M; buyer pool is family/right-sizer, not investor
Low-rise 4-6 storeys: no high-floor premium available; view is GCB rooftops / park at best
